versions.content: requirement MaxDeltaCounter for Client-Server Communication (server) Replaces: PRS_E2E_CONSTR_06300 [PRS_E2E_01447] Upstream: RS_E2E_08528 For Client-Server Communication the MaxDeltaCounter on server-side shall be set to the maximum of the value range of the sequence counter For Client-Server Communication the MaxDeltaCounter on server-side shall be set to the maximum of the value range of the sequence counter MaxDeltaCounter
